hebrewText: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֞ע פִּֽינְחָ֣ס הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וּ/נְשִׂיאֵ֨י הָ/עֵדָ֜ה וְ/רָאשֵׁ֨י אַלְפֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ אֶת הַ֨/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר דִּבְּר֛וּ בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֥ן וּ/בְנֵי גָ֖ד וּ/בְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַ/יִּיטַ֖ב בְּ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם

tokens.bdb: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)

tokens.bdb: Pinechas, the name of three Israelites
tokens.kjv: Phinehas.

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: properly, an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik; also a rising mist
tokens.kjv: captain, chief, cloud, governor, prince, ruler, vapour.

tokens.bdb: a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd)
tokens.kjv: assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare H5713 (עֵדָה).

tokens.bdb: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

tokens.bdb: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand
tokens.kjv: thousand.

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.kjv: Israel.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
